subject: Acme Health — Hosted API pricing delta / sanction request
messages:
From: Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jan 2028 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing — request for deeper concession

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the demo last week — the engineers at Acme are excited about the latency profile and the prefix caching behavior you showed. We have a multi-year pilot that will ramp to ~800M tokens/mo by Q4 if we go live, plus an embedding surface for search across 12M patient records.

To commit today we need a meaningful unit-price concession. Our procurement team is asking whether Redwood can offer a 30% discount off list for the first 12 months in exchange for a 24-month committed contract (with a standard annual escalation after year one). Given the volume and the fact we’d onboard into our VPC in Q3, this is critical for internal approvals.

Attached: Q1_2028_Acme_LOI.pdf (letter of intent)

Can you advise next steps and whether this is something you can escalate?

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Gonzales
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jan 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — request for deeper concession

Team — forwarding Acme’s LOI and ask. Summary: they want 30% off list for first 12 months in exchange for a 24-month commit and VPC/onboarding. Expected ramp to ~800M tokens/mo by Q4 and embeddings usage for search. They indicated timing pressure to close procurement approvals this week.

My recommendation: consider a one-year introductory discount capped at 22% with two conditions: 1) minimum committed monthly spend of $X (proposal in attached spreadsheet) and 2) SLA clause + audit window (limited retention policy). This keeps our unit economics intact while giving them the concession they need to sign.

Attachments: Proposal_ACME_HostedAPI_2028.xlsx, SOW_ACME_hostedapi_v3.docx

Requesting alignment and an exec-signed sanction to offer 22% (exceeds standard 20% deal desk limit). If we can get leadership sign-off today we can route DocuSign and aim to close by EOD Thursday.

Thoughts?
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — request for deeper concession

Evelyn — thanks for the clear summary. I support a conditional 22% introductory concession for 12 months with the minimum committed monthly spend and SLA language in the SOW. Key asks for leadership:
- Documented walk-back clause if they fail to hit committed spend in Q1/Q2.
- Auto-fallback to standard list pricing after promo period.
- Legal to sign off on data controls in the SOW (they’re touching patient records).

Copying legal and CS would be ideal but I think commercial is comfortable recommending this to leadership as long as finance signs off. I’ve added a note to the HubSpot deal and attached internal margin calc.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Deal Desk (Commercial)

On Mon, 9 Jan 2028 at 15:03, Evelyn Hart wrote:
> Team — forwarding Acme’s LOI and ask. Summary: they want 30% off list for first 12 months in exchange for a 24-month commit and VPC/onboarding...

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing — request for deeper concession (Finance conditional)

Team — finance review complete. We can provisionally approve a 22% introductory concession for the first 12 months under these non-negotiable conditions:
1) Minimum committed monthly spend of $60,000 (net) for the first 12 months.
2) 24-month contract term required, with an annual true-up and a one-time reconciliation at month 6.
3) SLA and security addenda must be signed (legal to confirm wording).
4) A clawback clause if committed spend not met: pro-rated recovery of promotional discount for shortfalls below the quarterly threshold.

If leadership (Rishi / Evelyn) approves the above we will prepare the commercial concession memo and the DocuSign packet. I will not approve anything above 22% without C-suite escalation.

Mina Haddad
Director of Finance — Commercial GTM
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 10 Jan 2028 at 09:45, Ben Carter wrote:
> Evelyn — thanks for the clear summary. I support a conditional 22% introductory concession...

P.S. Evelyn — please confirm whether Acme accepts the minimum monthly commitment; if not we should propose a phased ramp instead of a blanket promo.
